notes: Version 2.0 aligns the note with the published status of every constituent. The step from the capacity exponent to the cascade exponent leaves the derivation chain: O24 closes the fibre-structure conditionality of c_chi -> delta_pair only and states that it does not establish the capacity-to-rate step, O25 and O14 report no beta* diagnostic from these data, and the Span-Growth Note proves the expander-derived conversion does not transfer to the Heisenberg substrate, so the agreement of beta* = 0.126 with the charged-lepton window is a coincidence check. The O31 record is a withdrawal notice, so the SU(3) identification, the colour-group derivation and every derivation of a gauge factor are withdrawn; the two H-color levels established in O32 stand and the two that rested on O31 are open. On the SU(2) side the su(2) identification is conditional on the neutral-sector identification O27 assumes and on the carrier O23 supplies, d_rho = 2 is O26's minimality selection, the adjoint reading of H_eff is supplied rather than derived, and O30's ratio is a conditional 3x3 model that gives no account of the covariance measured in O28. The finite Heisenberg carrier and its associated Weil action are recorded as distinct supplied objects, HeisenbergStructure having disproved carrier selection from the axioms by a six-element countermodel. A constituent-by-constituent audit against the deposited sources restates O1, O3, O4, O5, O7, O8, O6, O9, O12, O13, O15, O16, O17, O20, O21, O25, O32, O33, SpectralCapacity, SpectralRelaxation and ThreeGenerations: in particular O12's fitted slopes are a finite-q crossover statistic whose unfolded exponent is delta_exact = 3, O13 rules out the finite-size hypothesis only in its strong form and requalifies the tension, O16 asserts no value of the pair exponent, O32 is reported against its own criterion R <= 3, O33 makes no Standard-Model identification, the binary-cover dominance theorem gives Q8 at d = 6, 2O at d = 12 and 2I at d = 24 while general 2I maximality remains conjectural, and O25 assigns the admissible-window agreement to the raw exponent rather than to the adjusted one. Seventeen cited titles are synchronised after resolving every DOI in the file, and the Span-Growth Note, the Critical Coverage Note and O33 are added as constituents.
